heading: Packages — Frequently Asked Questions
subheading: Everything you need to know before you get started.

items.question: What exactly do I get for ₹4,999?
items.answer: A complete, live, multi-page portfolio website built around your work — not a generic template. That includes email & WhatsApp integration, SEO & GEO setup so you get found on Google and AI search tools, an admin dashboard (CMS) to edit your own content, Google Analytics, performance testing, and we set up your initial content for you. Free hosting, free SSL, mobile-friendly design, a live walkthrough call, and 7 days of free bug fixes after launch are all included at no extra cost.

items.question: How long does it take to launch my portfolio website?
items.answer: The Portfolio Website Package is delivered in 7 days from kickoff to live site, depending on how quickly we receive your content (bio, project details, images). We handle the initial content setup with you so your first version launches fast, not months later.

items.question: Is the free hosting really free, or is there a catch?
items.answer: It's free — you'll never get a hosting bill from us. We host your site on our own infrastructure at no cost to you, for as long as we're your hosting provider. Free SSL security (the padlock icon) is included too, so your site is fast, secure, and trusted by visitors and search engines from day one.

items.question: Can I update my own website content after it's live?
items.answer: Yes. Every Portfolio Website Package includes an admin dashboard (CMS), so you can update text, images, and projects yourself anytime — no coding required. We also walk you through it personally on a live call after launch.

items.question: What does "SEO & GEO ready" actually mean?
items.answer: Your site is built with technical SEO best practices so it can get found on Google, plus GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) so it shows up correctly when people search using AI tools like ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews. Google Analytics is set up from launch so you can see exactly who's visiting and where they're coming from.

items.question: What happens after the 7 days of free bug fixes ends?
items.answer: Any bugs found within 7 days of launch are fixed free of charge. After that, your site keeps running on our free hosting with no maintenance required for normal use — and you can reach out anytime if you need further changes or a support plan.

items.question: Do I need any technical or coding knowledge to manage my site?
items.answer: No. The admin dashboard is built for non-technical use, and we personally walk you through managing your own site on a live call before you're on your own. If you can use email, you can update your portfolio.

items.question: Can visitors contact me directly through the website?
items.answer: Yes — the package includes both email and WhatsApp integration, so visitors can reach you directly with no middleman or third-party contact forms getting in the way.

items.question: Can I add more pages or features later?
items.answer: Yes. The Portfolio Website Package is a multi-page site built to grow with you — additional pages, features, or a custom domain can be added on top whenever you're ready. Get in touch and we'll scope it out.

items.question: Do you offer website design and development services in Balussery, Nanmanda, Kakkur, Narikkuni, Kakkodi, or Kunnamangalam?
items.answer: Yes. Alongside Calicut city, we provide website design, website designing, website development, web development, and software development services across Kozhikode district — including Balussery, Nanmanda (also searched as Nanminda), Kakkur, Narikkuni, Kakkodi, and Kunnamangalam. Since delivery is fully remote with a live walkthrough call included, you get the same Portfolio Website Package no matter where in Kozhikode district you're based.

items.question: Do you build ecommerce websites and landing pages for businesses in Kerala?
items.answer: Yes. As ecommerce website developers, we build complete online stores through our Basic and Stable Ecommerce Packages, as well as focused landing pages for businesses that just need one high-converting page. We work with clients across Kerala, not just Kozhikode — since every project is delivered remotely with a live walkthrough call, you get the same ecommerce website or landing page development, pricing, and turnaround no matter which city or town in Kerala you're based in.

items.question: Are you website developers and software developers who work with clients across all of Kerala?
items.answer: Yes. We're based in Kozhikode and serve the district closely, but as website developers and software developers we take on projects from businesses across Kerala — including Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, Kannur, and Malappuram. Whether you need a website, an ecommerce store, or custom software, everything is scoped, built, and handed off remotely, with a live walkthrough call so location within Kerala never affects your price or delivery timeline.
